encuadre.pregunta_analitica: ¿Las contribuciones al cambio observado entre dic-22 y oct-24 (MRR pagado, clientes activos y MRR por cliente activo) se concentran en un subconjunto de industrias con base suficiente, o el cambio está difundido dentro de todas las industrias?

firma.si_es_falsa: Las contribuciones absolutas se reparten entre varias industrias en proporción a su tamaño y ninguna domina; el patrón de cambio aparece en todas las industrias.

hipotesis.pregunta: ¿La cobertura del corte por industria conserva el total (sin categoría sin industria ni pérdida de join) y por eso el patrón no es un artefacto de cobertura?

firma.si_es_cierta: La suma de las industrias reproduce el total de MRR y de clientes activos del mes, sin filas sin industria; el patrón de concentración se sostiene sobre bases completas.
firma.si_es_falsa: Existe una categoría sin industria o la suma de cortes no reproduce el total, y esa brecha coincide con el cambio atribuido a alguna industria.

firma.si_es_falsa: El componente dentro de industria domina la descomposición y el mix aporta una fracción menor, con intervalos que incluyen valores pequeños.

params.proposito: Cobertura del corte (categoría sin industria) y contribución absoluta de cada industria al cambio de MRR pagado y de clientes activos entre dic-22 y oct-24
params.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(sin industria)') AS ind,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2022-12' THEN paid_mrr_cop ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_ini,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2024-10' THEN paid_mrr_cop ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_fin,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2022-12' THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act_ini,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2024-10' THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act_fin
  FROM mart.customer_month
  WHERE active_customer = 1
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ind,
  act_ini, act_fin, act_fin - act_ini AS delta_clientes,
  ROUND(100.0 * (act_fin - act_ini) / SUM(act_fin - act_ini) OVER (), 1) AS pct_delta_clientes,
  ROUND(mrr_ini/1000000.0, 2) AS mrr_ini_mm, ROUND(mrr_fin/1000000.0, 2) AS mrr_fin_mm,
  ROUND((mrr_fin - mrr_ini)/1000000.0, 2) AS delta_mrr_mm,
  ROUND(100.0 * (mrr_fin - mrr_ini) / SUM(mrr_fin - mrr_ini) OVER (), 1) AS pct_delta_mrr
FROM base
ORDER BY delta_mrr_mm DESC

params.sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(sin industria)') AS ind,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN churned_customer ELSE 0 END) AS ch24,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act24,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 AND month_index >= 2 THEN churned_customer ELSE 0 END) AS ch22,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 AND month_index >= 2 THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act22
  FROM mart.customer_month
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ind,
  CAST(ch24 AS BIGINT) AS churns_2024,
  ch24 / NULLIF(act24, 0) AS tasa_2024,
  ch24 / SUM(ch24) OVER () AS share_churns_2024,
  act24 / SUM(act24) OVER () AS share_activos_2024,
  (ch24 / SUM(ch24) OVER ()) - (act24 / SUM(act24) OVER ()) AS exceso_2024,
  ch22 / NULLIF(act22, 0) AS tasa_2022
FROM b
ORDER BY exceso_2024 DESC

params.proposito: Cobertura del corte (categoría sin industria) y contribución absoluta de cada industria al cambio de MRR pagado y de clientes activos entre dic-22 y oct-24
params.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(sin industria)') AS ind,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2022-12' THEN paid_mrr_cop ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_ini,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2024-10' THEN paid_mrr_cop ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_fin,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2022-12' THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act_ini,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2024-10' THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act_fin
  FROM mart.customer_month
  WHERE active_customer = 1
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ind,
  act_ini, act_fin, act_fin - act_ini AS delta_clientes,
  ROUND(100.0 * (act_fin - act_ini) / SUM(act_fin - act_ini) OVER (), 1) AS pct_delta_clientes,
  ROUND(mrr_ini/1000000.0, 2) AS mrr_ini_mm, ROUND(mrr_fin/1000000.0, 2) AS mrr_fin_mm,
  ROUND((mrr_fin - mrr_ini)/1000000.0, 2) AS delta_mrr_mm,
  ROUND(100.0 * (mrr_fin - mrr_ini) / SUM(mrr_fin - mrr_ini) OVER (), 1) AS pct_delta_mrr
FROM base
ORDER BY delta_mrr_mm DESC

params.proposito: Contribución de cada industria al cambio de MRR pagado y clientes activos entre dic-22 y oct-24, en COP y como fracción del cambio total, con MRR por cliente activo de cada extremo
params.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(sin industria)') AS ind,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2022-12' THEN paid_mrr_cop ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_ini,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2024-10' THEN paid_mrr_cop ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_fin,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2022-12' THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act_ini,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(CAST(month AS VARCHAR),1,7) = '2024-10' THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act_fin
  FROM mart.customer_month
  WHERE active_customer = 1
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ind,
  CAST(act_ini AS BIGINT) AS clientes_ini, CAST(act_fin AS BIGINT) AS clientes_fin,
  CAST(act_fin - act_ini AS BIGINT) AS delta_clientes,
  (act_fin - act_ini) / SUM(act_fin - act_ini) OVER () AS share_delta_clientes,
  mrr_ini AS mrr_ini_cop, mrr_fin AS mrr_fin_cop,
  mrr_fin - mrr_ini AS delta_mrr_cop,
  (mrr_fin - mrr_ini) / SUM(mrr_fin - mrr_ini) OVER () AS share_delta_mrr,
  mrr_ini / act_ini AS arpa_ini_cop, mrr_fin / act_fin AS arpa_fin_cop,
  (mrr_fin / act_fin) / (mrr_ini / act_ini) - 1 AS arpa_cambio_pct,
  act_fin / act_ini AS clientes_multiplo
FROM base
ORDER BY delta_mrr_cop DESC

params.sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(sin industria)') AS ind,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN churned_customer ELSE 0 END) AS ch24,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act24,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 AND month_index >= 2 THEN churned_customer ELSE 0 END) AS ch22,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 AND month_index >= 2 THEN active_customer ELSE 0 END) AS act22
  FROM mart.customer_month
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ind,
  CAST(ch24 AS BIGINT) AS churns_2024,
  ch24 / NULLIF(act24, 0) AS tasa_2024,
  ch24 / SUM(ch24) OVER () AS share_churns_2024,
  act24 / SUM(act24) OVER () AS share_activos_2024,
  (ch24 / SUM(ch24) OVER ()) - (act24 / SUM(act24) OVER ()) AS exceso_2024,
  ch22 / NULLIF(act22, 0) AS tasa_2022
FROM b
ORDER BY exceso_2024 DESC
